location_description: Alhambra ( (listen),  (listen), Spanish: [aˈlambɾa]; from "Alhambra")  is a city located in the western San Gabriel Valley region of Los Angeles County, California, United States, approximately eight miles from the Downtown Los Angeles civic center. It was incorporated on July 11, 1903. As of the 2020 census, the population was 82,868.
